profile.research_note: Multiple third-party aggregators (Data Center Tracker, Baxtel, datacenters.com) independently list a Google facility referred to as West Tower in Thornton, Colorado (Denver metro), and job listing sites show Google Data Center Technician postings for Thornton, CO, corroborating an operational presence. However, this facility does not appear on Google's own official datacenters.google location list, which suggests it may be a smaller leased or edge facility rather than one of Google's named hyperscale campuses. Treated as plausible but not confirmed by a tier-1 Google source.
